entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Can you hear me?#nNaomi?
entries.context: Mei checks radio contact with Naomi.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: Comms are clear.#nMei, I can hear you just fine.
entries.context: Naomi replies to Mei's radio check.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Okay.#nThen let's start the test.
entries.context: Mei begins Naomi's handling test.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: First, I'll explain how to operate a Para-mail.#nListen carefully.
entries.context: Mei introduces pilot controls to Naomi.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: First, use #b4 to move left, right, up, and down.
entries.context: Mei explains directional movement.
entries.decisions: Restore a full instruction from the source's noun phrase; do not replace the button token with a guessed physical control.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Then press #b0 to transform from Flight Mode#nto Destroyer Mode.
entries.context: Mei explains transformation.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: When you want to change from Destroyer Mode back to Flight Mode,#nuse #b0 again. Don't forget!
entries.context: Mei explains reverse transformation.
entries.decisions: Keep #n before #b0; mode names follow licensed Good Smile wording.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Press #b7 when you want to accelerate.#nIt'll give you a big burst of speed.
entries.context: Mei explains acceleration.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: And if you want to slow down, use #b2.
entries.context: Mei contrasts braking with acceleration.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Press #b7 or #b2 twice in quick succession#nto perform an emergency dodge.
entries.context: Mei explains the emergency dodge.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Use it when you want to dodge an enemy attack.
entries.context: Mei explains when to use the dodge.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: After an emergency dodge, hold down #b7#nto keep moving with boost.
entries.context: Mei explains boost after dodging.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: But you can't keep boosting forever.#nLook at the gauge marked BOOST at the bottom.
entries.context: Mei warns Naomi about boost limits.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: If that gauge runs out, you won't be able to boost,#nand you'll have to wait a while before you can boost again.
entries.context: Mei explains depletion and recovery delay.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Always keep an eye on the boost gauge.#nDo you understand?
entries.context: Mei checks Naomi understands the warning.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: All right, let's try flying around freely for a bit.
entries.context: Mei sends Naomi into free flight.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: You seem to have no trouble handling the machine.#nLet's keep going with the test.
entries.context: Mei assesses free-flight handling.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Okay, let's try heading to your destination.
entries.context: Mei gives Naomi the destination exercise.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: My destination?#nHow do I get there?
entries.context: Naomi asks how to reach the destination.
entries.decisions: Retain the deliberate echo-question fragment, then restore I in the full question.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Oh, right. I'll explain the radar.
entries.context: Mei realizes Naomi needs a radar explanation.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: You can see the round display at the bottom left, right?#nThe center is you, Naomi. That's your machine's position.
entries.context: Mei identifies Naomi's position on radar.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Look around the edge of the radar to see which direction#nyou're flying in. ...You understand that, right?
entries.context: Mei explains compass headings with a teasing check.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: D-don't treat me like an idiot!#nI learned all this properly. Um...
entries.context: Naomi indignantly answers Mei's teasing.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: N is north, and S is south.#nE is east, and W is west, right?
entries.context: Naomi recites compass directions to Mei.
entries.decisions: Normalize full-width compass letters to N/S/E/W; these are player-readable labels.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Very good♪ If you want to go north, just fly toward#nthe N on your radar. Easy, right?
entries.context: Mei praises Naomi and explains northward travel.
entries.decisions: Retain the musical note and playful praise; keep the radar instruction across #n.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Now, about the symbols on your radar:#n#b16 shows your objective.
entries.context: Mei explains the objective radar marker.
entries.decisions: Treat the icon as an objective marker rather than an enemy target, per row27.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: So I just need to fly toward the #b16 on my radar, right?
entries.context: Naomi checks her understanding of the marker.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: That's right.
entries.context: Mei confirms Naomi's understanding.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: They aren't showing up right now, but #b17 marks enemies.#n#b18 marks friendly machines.
entries.context: Mei explains enemy and allied markers.
entries.decisions: Plural display absence covers enemy/friendly markers; retain #b17, #n, #b18 order.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Also, the radar covers a wider area in Flight Mode#nthan it does in Destroyer Mode.
entries.context: Mei compares radar range in both modes.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Remember that.
entries.context: Mei reinforces the radar lesson.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Okay, try heading to your destination.
entries.context: Mei starts the navigation exercise.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: That's far enough.#nLet's move on to the next test.
entries.context: Mei stops Naomi at the destination.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: Whoa! That startled me!
entries.context: Naomi reacts to the sudden practice target.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: It's a target for simulated combat.#nCheck your radar, too.
entries.context: Mei explains the practice target.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: There's a #b17 on the radar.#nSo that means it's an enemy...
entries.context: Naomi notices the enemy marker.
entries.decisions: Retain the trailing ellipsis as realization; restore a full predicate.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Of course, it won't attack you,#nso don't worry.
entries.context: Mei reassures Naomi about the target.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Now, I'll explain how to attack. You've been waiting for this!
entries.context: Mei starts the attack tutorial.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Use #b1 to shoot and #b3 for melee attacks.#nThose are the basics, so don't forget them.
entries.context: Mei explains basic attack inputs.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Bring an enemy inside the white circle on the screen#nto acquire it as a target.
entries.context: Mei explains acquiring enemies in the targeting circle.
entries.decisions: Use acquire for detection and lock on for the separate row42 mechanic.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: When you attack like this, you'll aim at#nthe closest enemy you've acquired.
entries.context: Mei explains automatic closest-target selection.
entries.decisions: Closest enemy is selected from acquired enemies, not every enemy on the map.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: Once you've acquired an enemy, press #b6#nto lock on to it.
entries.context: Mei explains locking onto an acquired enemy.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: That lets you keep aiming at the same enemy.#nPress #b6 again to release the lock.
entries.context: Mei explains sustained lock and unlocking.
entries.decisions: Source says press again to unlock; preserve this instruction despite row44's release wording.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: When you release #b6, you'll go back to targeting#nthe nearest enemy.
entries.context: Mei continues explaining return to nearest-target selection.
entries.decisions: Source says release, whereas row43 says press again. Translate literal source; runtime verification required.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: That's about it for the basic controls.#nAs for the finer details—
entries.context: Mei finishes verbal basics, introducing details.
entries.decisions: Retain intentional unfinished clause leading to instruction cards.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: They work like this.
entries.context: Mei introduces the on-screen instruction cards.
entries.decisions: Restore They work to make the Japanese deictic fragment a full English statement.

entries.en: — Basic Battle Controls —
entries.context: First tutorial card heading.
entries.decisions: Retain heading form; no grammatical subject is expected.

entries.en: The controls for Flight Mode and Destroyer Mode are#nbasically the same, but—
entries.context: System card contrasts shared controls; sentence continues in row49.
entries.decisions: Retain deliberate sentence continuation into row49; do not merge the rows.

entries.en: Quick turns, Freeze Bullets, and melee attacks#nare only available in Destroyer Mode.
entries.context: System card lists Destroyer Mode-only actions.
entries.decisions: Quick turn is a control action; Freeze Bullet follows dedicated Villkiss wiki.

entries.en: You can also configure your machine's controls#nin BATTLE CONFIG.
entries.context: System card points to the control configuration menu.
entries.decisions: Preserve BATTLE CONFIG as the player-visible English menu label; normalize width and spacing.

entries.en: — Battle Screen Guide —
entries.context: Second tutorial card heading.
entries.decisions: Retain heading form; no grammatical subject is expected.

entries.en: The radar displays a wider area in Flight Mode#nthan in Destroyer Mode.
entries.context: System card compares radar coverage.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.en: Flight Mode specializes in movement,#nand restores more of your spent BOOST.
entries.context: System card explains movement-mode boost recovery.
entries.decisions: Source states recovered amount increases, not explicitly recovery speed. Avoid inventing faster regeneration.

entries.en: Destroyer Mode specializes in attacks,#nand lets you use melee attacks and Freeze Bullets.
entries.context: System card explains combat-mode attacks.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.en: Use #b12 to toggle Freeze Bullets ON or OFF.
entries.context: System card explains Freeze Bullet toggle.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.en: When Freeze Bullets are ON, hold down #b3#nto charge the gauge.
entries.context: System card explains charging a Freeze Bullet.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.en: Once the gauge is charged, release #b3#nto fire a Freeze Bullet.
entries.context: System card explains firing a charged Freeze Bullet.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Mei
entries.en: That's everything explained.#nNow, try attacking the target.
entries.context: Mei resumes dialogue and asks Naomi to attack.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Olivier
entries.en: No DRAGONs remain.#nCombat operations are now concluded.
entries.context: Olivier reports combat completion over radio.
entries.decisions: Use clipped military reporting; zero count stated explicitly.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: Did we win...?#nWhat happened to Ange? What happened to everyone else?
entries.context: Naomi asks about victory and squadmates.
entries.decisions: Restore what happened in both questions about Ange and squadmates, avoiding assumed injury or gender of unknown referents.

entries.speaker: Olivier
entries.en: All of the First Squadron's Para-mails are still intact.#nNaomi, please return to Arzenal.
entries.context: Olivier answers Naomi about the First Squadron and orders return.
entries.decisions: Source means intact or operational; do not claim all machines are undamaged.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: We beat the DRAGONs... We really did...
entries.context: Naomi reflects in disbelief on victory.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: Roger!#nNaomi, returning to Arzenal!
entries.context: Naomi acknowledges Olivier's return instruction.
entries.decisions: Retain Naomi's radio self-identification rather than replacing it with an inferred callsign. Retain deliberate radio-report fragment returning; implied speaker I is flagged.

entries.speaker: Hikaru
entries.en: All Singularity readings have disappeared.#nThere are no signs of DRAGONs in the area.
entries.context: Hikaru reports all rift readings gone.
entries.decisions: Singular is retained as a named rift phenomenon; exact English game terminology remains provisional.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: I've found Villkiss stranded on the beach!#nI'm landing!
entries.context: Naomi spots disabled Villkiss and announces landing.
entries.decisions: Source appears to have a homophone typo for stranded or grounded; render the disabled/beached state as stranded. Naomi is landing, not commanding Ange to land.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: Ange, please!#nPlease be okay!!
entries.context: Naomi fears for Ange's safety.
entries.decisions: Preserve urgent plea and double exclamation; do not reverse direction into offering help.

entries.speaker: Olivier
entries.en: Combat has ended. Standing down from contact alert.#nAll Para-mails, please return to Arzenal.
entries.context: Olivier announces another combat ending and return.
entries.decisions: Source means alert for enemy contact. Specific alert-level wording is provisional.

entries.speaker: Salia
entries.en: Good work.#nSo, how did it go?
entries.context: Salia asks Naomi about the result of their outing.
entries.decisions: Row69 answers in terms of earnings, so use how did it go rather than physical combat impact.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: It looks like we've just about earned enough for the ingredients.
entries.context: Naomi answers in terms of money for ingredients.
entries.decisions: Restore we earned from the combat/ingredient-money context; not a claim of exact earnings.

entries.speaker: Rosalie
entries.en: As soon as we're back, let's withdraw the money and throw it#nin Jasmine's face before the King of Debt changes her mind.
entries.context: Rosalie urges prompt payment to Jasmine, teasing Naomi.
entries.decisions: King of Debt retains sourced nickname despite female Naomi; restore her from known referent. Throw it in Jasmine's face conveys forceful payment.

entries.speaker: Ersha
entries.en: Once we've got all the ingredients, we can finally start cooking.#nI can't wait to see what dishes we'll make.
entries.context: Ersha looks forward to the cooking.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Hilda
entries.en: ...Tch. You're all so damn excited.#nIt's not like it'll be anything special.
entries.context: Hilda dismisses the others' excitement.
entries.decisions: Retain Hilda's contempt and rough tone; do not turn this into polite skepticism.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: You'll have to wait until it's ready to find out, Hilda.#nCome on, let's go back.
entries.context: Naomi playfully answers Hilda and calls for return.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Rosalie
entries.en: What's that? A transport's wandered into the combat zone.#nThat's dangerous. It could get caught in the crossfire.
entries.context: Rosalie spots a transport amidst fighting.
entries.decisions: Transport risks involvement in their fighting; use crossfire without assigning gender to occupants.

entries.speaker: Salia
entries.en: That's... a Rosenblum transport.#nI wonder why it's flying out here.
entries.context: Salia identifies the transport.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

entries.speaker: Rosalie
entries.en: Tch. They aren't answering our calls.#nWhat do we do, Captain?!
entries.context: Rosalie reports no radio reply and addresses Salia.
entries.decisions: Unknown transport occupants use they; captain addressed is Salia, established by reply77.

entries.speaker: Salia
entries.en: I suppose we have no choice. Drive off the DRAGONs around it#nto help them out. There's no need to do anything more.
entries.context: Salia orders limited assistance to the transport.
entries.decisions: Salia orders others to aid transport occupants and limits involvement; restore them neutrally.

entries.speaker: Chris
entries.en: Got it!
entries.context: Chris acknowledges Salia's order.
entries.decisions: Retain idiomatic acknowledgement Got it with omitted I; flagged for reviewer.

entries.speaker: Salia
entries.en: The rest of us will keep taking down the DRAGONs!
entries.context: Salia tells the remaining group to continue the hunt.
entries.decisions: The rest of us contrasts the remaining hunters with the group clearing the transport's vicinity.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: Yes, ma'am!
entries.context: Naomi acknowledges Salia; rows81–90 show post-battle aftermath.
entries.decisions: Restore clear subjects where needed; preserve source control tokens and natural spoken tone.

translation_notes.notes: Rows59 onward are separate battle-end scenes, not a continuous tutorial. Commands and source-file boundaries were checked. Every source token remains in order. No byte budget assumed; rendered fit unverified.
